title: Foundations: Folk Metal - The Complete Guide
summary: What Folk Metal is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Folk Metal songs: Folk metal marries traditional instruments — fiddles, flutes, accordions, bagpipes — to metal riffs, singing of battles, myths, and drinking. The pit does a folk dance.

History: Skyclad (1990) coined it; Finntroll (humppa metal), Korpiklaani, and Eluveitie (Celtic metal) made it a festival phenomenon in the 2000s.

How the songs work: Folk Metal favors the keys of Em, Am, Dm, Bm. Common forms include Folk melody intro, metal verse, folk-metal chorus; Drinking-song singalongs at double speed. Players should master fiddle and accordion doubling the guitar riff first, then folk-dance rhythms under blast beats. Folk instruments set the key; guitars follow.
